item.title: TLS Handshake and Certificates
item.description: TLS builds a secure channel over an untrusted network by providing confidentiality, integrity, and authentication. A walkthrough of symmetric/asymmetric hybrid encryption, the TLS 1.2 handshake, the certificate and PKI trust model, and what TLS 1.3 improved.
